children: Vishay Intertechnology, Inc. (NYSE:VSH) is expanding its power portfolio with IFBT SMD flyback transformers and four AEC-Q200 automotive SMD common-mode chokes — high-temp, high-isolation parts with broad output and current ranges — and will showcase these and AI power semiconductors and passives at PCIM Asia 2026.
: Vishay (VSH) launched IFBT series SMD flyback transformers for 26–72V input, 1500VRMS isolation, outputs 1.8–24V, 0.5–9A, −40–125°C. Samples and production available; 10–12 week lead times.
: Vishay (VSH) added four Automotive Grade surface‑mount common‑mode chokes (ICM5050‑A, ICM6050‑A, IFLN‑1210BE‑A, IFLN‑1812CZ‑A): up to 14 A, 0.4–12 mΩ, 11 kΩ@100MHz, +150°C, AEC‑Q200.
: Vishay (VSH) will exhibit at PCIM Asia 2026 in Shenzhen Aug 26–28, showcasing semiconductors and passives for AI power: SSTs, HVDC, AC/DC, DC/DC, MOSFETs, SiC diodes, inductors, resistors.
